rdfs:label: hasCategory
rdfs:comment: A category or tag for the vCard — describing what kind of contact it is.
notes: vCard's category/tag predicate. For plain string tags ("work", "family") use vcard:category (http://www.w3.org/2006/vcard/ns#category); hasCategory is the object form (category node or concept IRI). Repeat for multiple categories. For general-purpose tagging of resources (not specifically vCards), prefer `urn:solid:keywords` or `urn:solid:subject`.

examples.title: vCard categorized as a work contact

history.note: Notes distinguish object property hasCategory from vcard:category; added vcard:category to seeAlso; example uses category IRIs.
